info.title: SchachBotManager web API
info.description: Web API of SchachBotManager (backend-api.md, E73): public reading of matches, bots and the game queue; sessions, accounts and administration for invited users (E83, E84, E85); uploading bots and their verification (E91, E92, E93); own bots with their versions and source, and single games set by their owners (E95, E96, E97, E98); disciplines (E100); ratings of bots (E103); games of people and remote bots in the lists like those of bots (E119); leagues with seasons, registrations and tables (E131–E137); tournaments with editions in three formats and a calendar for leagues and tournaments (E170–E180). All times are UTC in RFC 3339; durations are milliseconds. Errors carry a code that the frontend translates (E32). Requests other than GET need the header X-SBM-CSRF: 1 (E84).

get.summary: Liveness of the API and its database connection.

200.description: The API answers and reaches the database.

get.summary: Matches, newest first, without their moves.

parameters.name: bot_id
parameters.description: Only matches in which this bot plays either colour.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: bots: only matches between two bots (types single, league and tournament); players: only games of people in the browser and of remote bots (types human and remote, E119).

parameters.name: discipline_id
parameters.description: Only matches played under this stored discipline (E156).

parameters.name: opponent_id
parameters.description: Only with bot_id: only matches of these two bots against each other (E156).

parameters.name: season_id
parameters.description: Only the matches of this league season (E137).

parameters.name: edition_id
parameters.description: Only the matches of this tournament edition (E178).

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Only with season_id: only the matches of this tier.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: true: only matches the signed-in account set with POST /matches or POST /admin/matches (E156); needs a session.

post.summary: Puts single games between two verified bots into the queue, at least one of them the account's own (E98). The games a day per account are limited (E154); they start after the matches of admins. Two or more games form a series (E155).

201.description: The new matches in the order they were queued.

get.summary: One match with all moves played so far.
The match as PGN, also while it runs (result * until it ends).

post.summary: Takes a waiting single game the account set out of the queue (E157). The match ends as aborted; a game counted for the daily limit is given back while its day lasts.

get.summary: The games of one request with two or more games, in order, and the score (E155).

post.summary: The FEN after some half-moves of a game in a PGN, as a start position (coders and admins, E159). Nothing is stored.

get.summary: All verified bots, ordered by name and version.

post.summary: Uploads a bot as source files; the runner then verifies it (E91, E92). The same name as an own bot makes a new version of it, with a higher version number.

201.description: The new bot, waiting for its verification.

get.summary: One bot with the versions of its name. Verified, disabled and retired bots are public; the owner and admins also see the others, and they alone get the details with the verification report (E15, E95).

patch.summary: Changes the description of an own bot, or retires a verified one and makes it verified again (owner, E95, E96). A bot disabled by an admin stays disabled.

get.summary: One file of an uploaded bot as a download (owner and admins, E97). Bots that are not public are not found for others.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path as listed in the details.

200.description: The bytes of the file as uploaded.

Content-Disposition.description: Always attachment, with the file name.

get.summary: The record of a bot against every other bot it finished single games with, rated or not, most games first (E161). Visible like the bot.
The active league registrations of a bot (E137). Visible like the bot.
The started seasons this bot version played in, newest first, with its place; for a running season the current one (E139). Visible like the bot.
The rating of a bot before and after each counted game, per discipline in the order they were counted (E140). Visible like the bot.
Wins, draws and losses of a bot over all its finished games and per discipline (E141). Visible like the bot.
All files of an uploaded bot as a ZIP file named Name-Version.zip, in a folder Name-Version (owner and admins, E97).

Content-Disposition.description: Always attachment, with the file name.

get.summary: Running and waiting matches in queue order with estimated start times (E20).

Public bots with at least one rated match, highest rating first, then by name and version (E103). Without discipline_id by the overall rating, with it by the rating in that discipline, which is then the rating of each item (E163).

Active accounts with at least one rated game against bots, highest rating first, then by name (E118). Their games are public like all others (E119). Overall or in one discipline like the ranking of bots (E163).
All disciplines ordered by name, the archived ones included (E100).
One discipline (E100).
The active tournament registrations of a bot (E179). Visible like the bot.
The started tournament editions this bot version played in, newest first, with its place (E180). Visible like the bot.
All leagues ordered by name, the archived ones included (E137).
A league with its seasons and registrations (E137).

post.summary: Registers a verified bot for a league that is not archived (E136); the owner (coder) or an admin. The bot enters at the next season start.

delete.summary: Ends the registration of a bot; the owner (coder) or an admin. In a running season the bot withdraws: its waiting games become forfeit wins of the opponents (E136).

204.description: The bot is no longer registered.

get.summary: A season with the tables of its tiers (E135, E137); the final tables once it has finished.
The schedule of one tier of a started season by rounds and boards, with the state of each game (E138). 404 if the season does not have the tier (yet).
All tournaments ordered by name, the archived ones included (E180).
A tournament with its editions and registrations (E180).

post.summary: Registers a verified bot for a tournament that is not archived (E179); the owner (coder) or an admin. The bot enters at the next edition start.

delete.summary: Ends the registration of a bot; the owner (coder) or an admin. In a running edition the bot withdraws: its waiting games become forfeit wins of the opponents, in a knockout it loses its duel (E179).

204.description: The bot is no longer registered.

get.summary: A tournament edition with its participants and its table or bracket (E180); the final result once it has finished.
The games of a round robin or Swiss edition by rounds and boards with the state of each game and the bye (E180); no rounds for knockout.

post.summary: A game of the person against a verified bot, as guest or with the session's account (E11, E114). The answer names the seat to join over the WebSocket at socket_path (gateway-v1); the game itself speaks play-v1. The game is public like every match: in the lists, the queue and with its moves (E119).

201.description: The game waits for the person to join.

get.summary: Who is logged in; user is null for guests.

post.summary: Logs in and sets the session cookie.

delete.summary: Ends the session and clears the cookie; also fine without a session.

post.summary: Creates an account from an invite and logs it in (E4, E83).
Sets a new password with a reset link from an admin, ends all other sessions of the account and logs it in.

put.summary: Changes the own password and ends all other sessions of the account.

get.summary: The limits for the uploads and own matches of coders now in force (coders, E154).
The rating of the logged-in account from its rated games against bots (E117), overall and per discipline (E169); public in /ratings/players once it has a rated game (E118).

200.description: The rating; an account without rated games stands at the start and has no disciplines.

get.summary: The account's API tokens that are not revoked, newest first (coders, E116).

200.description: The tokens, without the tokens themselves.

post.summary: Makes an API token for remote bots (coders, E116); at most 10 per account. The token is in this answer only.

delete.summary: Revokes an own API token (coders, E116).

post.summary: A game of the token owner's local bot against a verified bot (coders, E116). The local bot joins its seat over the WebSocket at socket_path (gateway-v1) and then speaks the bot protocol v1. Never rated, public like every match (E119), within the play limits for the address, the account and the token (E115).

201.description: The game waits for the local bot to join.

get.summary: The bots of the logged-in account in every status, newest first.
All accounts, ordered by name (admin).

patch.summary: Changes role or active state of another account (admin); deactivation ends its sessions.

post.summary: A one-time link that sets a new password, valid for 24 hours (admin, E83). An earlier unused link of the account stops working.

201.description: The link; it is shown only this once.

get.summary: Unused invites that have not expired, newest first (admin).

post.summary: A new one-time invite (admin, E4).

201.description: The invite with its link; the link is shown only this once.

patch.summary: Disables a verified or retired bot, or makes a disabled one verified again (admin, E93, E96); queued matches of a disabled bot are aborted when their turn comes.

delete.summary: Deletes this version of a bot for good with its files, report and every match it played (admin, E105); the runner then counts all ratings again. The name is free once no version is left.

204.description: The bot and its matches are gone.

post.summary: A new discipline (admin, E100).

patch.summary: Changes or archives a discipline (admin, E100); queued and played matches keep their copy.

post.summary: A new league with its first season, planned by its calendar or until an admin starts it (admin, E131, E132, E171).

patch.summary: Changes or archives a league (admin, E131); a running season keeps its copy of the settings.

post.summary: Makes the planned season due now (admin, E132, E171): it starts as soon as enough bots are registered; with a calendar this pulls the next date forward.
A new tournament with its first edition, planned by its calendar or until an admin starts it (admin, E171, E172).

patch.summary: Changes or archives a tournament (admin, E172); a running edition keeps its copy of the settings.

post.summary: Makes the planned edition due now (admin, E171): it starts as soon as enough bots are registered; with a calendar this pulls the next date forward.

Checks every verified or rejected uploaded bot of a language again with the current rules (admin, E153); bots with a pending verification are left out. Each recheck only adds a report, the status stays.
Checks an uploaded bot again with the current rules (admin, E153); it waits like an upload (E89). The result is a report in the list rechecks; the status and the upload report stay.

202.description: The bot with the recheck pending.

post.summary: Verifies a rejected bot anyway, whatever the stage of its rejection (admin, E153); the rejection and the report stay on record.
Puts single games between two verified bots into the queue (admin, E71, E85).

201.description: The new matches in the order they were queued.

patch.summary: Changes the priority of a waiting single game (admin, E152); higher starts first.

post.summary: Takes a waiting single game out of the queue or stops a running one (admin, E152). The match ends as aborted and does not count.
Queues an ended single game again: same bots, colours, start position and priority, under the discipline as it is now (admin, E152).

get.summary: The limits of interactive games (admin, E115).

put.summary: Sets all limits of interactive games at once (admin, E115); they apply to games asked for from now on.

get.summary: The settings of coders, accounts, the rating rule and the queue estimate (admin, E154).

put.summary: Sets all limits of coders at once (admin, E154); they apply to uploads and requests from now on.
Sets invitation and login settings at once (admin, E154); invite_days may not exceed invite_max_days.
Sets the numbers of the rating rule at once (admin, E154); a change counts all ratings again (E105). min_win <= base <= max_win.
Sets how the queue estimates start times (admin, E154).

patch.summary: Pauses or resumes the queue (admin); a running match plays to its end.

200.description: The queue settings now in force.

get.summary: Entries of the audit log, newest first, with the actions and actors that occur (admin, E151).

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Only entries of this actor: a username, or cli for the command line.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Only entries with this action, such as bot.update.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Only entries about this target, usually the id of a bot, account, invite or discipline.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries from this day on (UTC).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only entries up to and including this day (UTC).

session.description: The session from POST /session, /invites/redeem or /password-resets/redeem: an HttpOnly cookie for /api/, SameSite=Strict, Secure behind HTTPS; valid until 14 days after its last use (E84).
session.name: sbm_session

token.description: A personal API token from POST /account/tokens as Authorization: Bearer sbm_…; only for remote matches (E116).

Csrf.name: X-SBM-CSRF
Csrf.description: Protection against cross-site requests: browsers send this header from other sites only after a CORS preflight, which the API never allows (E84). Without it the API answers 403 with code csrf_failed.

RankingDiscipline.name: discipline_id
RankingDiscipline.description: The ranking of this discipline; missing for the overall ranking (E163). An unknown discipline has an empty ranking.

Forbidden.description: The X-SBM-CSRF header is missing (code csrf_failed) or the account may not do this (code forbidden).

InvalidCredentials.description: Unknown name, wrong password or deactivated account (code invalid_credentials); for routes that need a session also unauthenticated.

TooManyAttempts.description: Too many attempts from this address or for this account; try again later (code too_many_attempts, E84).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the next attempt may succeed.

BadToken.description: A field is invalid (code invalid_parameter) or the link is unknown, used or expired (code invalid_token).

UsernameTaken.description: The name is in use, also in another case (code username_taken).

BadUpload.description: A field is invalid (code invalid_parameter), or the files break the upload rules (code invalid_upload, with the file to blame in path, if there is one).

NameTaken.description: The name belongs to a bot of another account or to a reference bot (code name_taken), or another upload of the name came first (code upload_conflict).

DisciplineNameTaken.description: Another discipline has the name, also in another case (code name_taken).

BotNotDeletable.description: A reference bot (code builtin_bot), a bot still being verified (code bot_verifying) or a bot in a running match (code bot_playing) cannot be deleted.

NotRecheckable.description: A reference bot (code builtin_bot), or a bot with a verification still queued or running (code bot_verifying), cannot be checked again.

NotRejected.description: Only a rejected bot can be verified anyway (code bot_state).

MatchState.description: The match is not a single game or not in a state that allows this (code match_state), or it cannot be queued again because a bot is no longer verified or its discipline is archived (code not_repeatable).

TooLarge.description: The request is larger than 3 MiB (code too_large).

PlayLimit.description: The address, account or token already plays a game (code too_many_games), or reached its games for the day (code too_many_attempts, with Retry-After) (E115).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the daily limit allows the next game; only with too_many_attempts.

NoCapacity.description: Every place for interactive games is taken; try again soon (code no_capacity, E115).

LeagueNameTaken.description: Another league has the name, also in another case (code name_taken).

LeagueState.description: The league is archived, has no planned season or its planned season is due already (code league_state).

RegistrationConflict.description: The bot is registered already (code already_registered), the league or tournament is archived (code league_state or tournament_state) or the bot is not verified (code bot_state).

TournamentNameTaken.description: Another tournament has the name, also in another case (code name_taken).

TournamentState.description: The tournament is archived, has no planned edition or its planned edition is due already (code tournament_state).

Id.description: Identifier of a document: 24 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

BotChoice.description: A bot, or random for one drawn anew for every game from all verified bots, never the bot on the other side (E162).

message.description: English text for logs; not shown to users, except as the detail of invalid_upload.

path.description: The file to blame, for invalid_upload.

MatchStatus.description: aborted: discarded after infrastructure errors and not played again (match-runner.md).

Termination.description: How the match ended: a code of the bot protocol, or forfeit_withdrawn for a league game not played because a bot left the league (E136).

Discipline.description: The conditions the match was played under, copied when it was created.

discipline_id.description: The stored discipline the match was queued under; null for free times (E100).

DisciplineName.description: 1 to 40 characters without control characters, unique regardless of case (E100); the API removes leading and trailing spaces.

StoredDiscipline.description: A discipline that matches, and later leagues, are played under (E100). Archived disciplines stay readable, but nothing new may use them.

startup_ms.description: Time for a bot to start and answer init.

tolerance_ms.description: Grace on every move for the transport.

max_moves.description: Full moves until the game is drawn.

DisciplineUpdate.description: At least one field; changes apply to matches queued afterwards.

Side.description: One side of a match: a bot, a person in the browser (human) or a coder's bot on their own machine (remote, E116). sdk and lang are filled once the bot reported ready; a person has neither.

bot_id.description: null for people and remote bots.

name.description: The bot's name; for people and remote bots the username, or Guest for a person without an account (E119).

version.description: Version of the bot; null for matches queued before versions were kept (E95).

rating.description: The rating of the bot or the account before and after the match; null until a rated match is counted, and for unrated matches (E103, E117).

Rating.description: Every bot version and every account starts at 2500 in every discipline; rated matches move it by the rule of E103 in their discipline. Unless a discipline is named, it is the overall rating: the mean over all disciplines weighted by their games, rounded half up (E163).

games.description: Rated matches counted so far, in all disciplines for the overall rating.

AccountRating.description: The overall rating of an account and the disciplines it played rated games in, by name (E163, E169).

DisciplineRating.description: The rating in one discipline; archived disciplines count as well (E169).

MatchFields.description: The fields of MatchSummary, open for extension by Match.

type.description: single: two bots from the queue; league: a game of a league season (E134); human: a person in the browser against a bot (E114); remote: a coder's bot on their own machine against a bot (E116); tournament: a game of a tournament edition (E178).

rated.description: Played under a stored discipline from the standard position between two different bots, or by a person with an account against a bot, unless asked otherwise; only such matches count for the rating (E100, E103, E117, E158).

series.description: The series of the match if it was queued with others in one request (E155); null otherwise.

league.description: Where a league game belongs (E137); null for other matches.

tournament.description: Where a tournament game belongs (E178); null for other matches.

clock_ms.description: The mover's remaining time after the move, increment included.

info.description: Search information the bot reported, public (E33).

SeriesPlace.description: Where a match stands in its series (E155).

SeriesBot.description: A bot of a series with its points: 1 a win, 0.5 a draw; aborted and open games do not count (E155).

Series.description: The games of one request with two or more games (E155); a is white in the first game.

counted.description: Finished games, the ones in the score.

matches.description: The games still stored, in order.

BotStatus.description: uploaded, analyzing, testing: in the verification; verified: plays; rejected: failed the verification; disabled: stopped by an admin; retired: withdrawn by its owner (verifikation.md, E96).

BotName.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, _ . or -, starting with a letter or digit; regardless of case the name of one owner's bots (E91).

BotVersion.description: X.Y.Z, each part 0 to 999 without leading zeros (E91).

BotFields.description: The fields of Bot, open for extension by BotDetail.

builtin.description: A reference bot shipped with the SDK (E68, E72).

description.description: Plain text by the owner, at most 500 characters; line breaks but no other control characters (E95).

owner.description: The username of the creator; null for reference bots (E164).

details.description: Only for the owner and admins; null for everyone else.

versions.description: The versions of the name the viewer may see, this one included, newest first (E95).

kind.description: data: a file for load_data in data/.

owner.description: Name of the owner; null for reference bots.

entry.description: The file the bot starts with; null for reference bots.

sdk_version.description: SDK version of the runtime that verified the bot.

overridden_at.description: When an admin verified the rejected bot anyway (E153); rejection and report stay.

report.description: The report of the upload; null until the verification ends, and for reference bots.

rechecks.description: Reports of the rechecks by admins, newest first, at most 20 (E153).

recheck_pending.description: A recheck is queued or running.

VerificationStageName.description: internal: the server could not verify the bot (E92).

Finding.description: A problem the static analysis found (statische-analyse.md).

TestGame.description: One Mindesttest: a game against the reference bot Random (verifikation.md).

truncated.description: Stage analysis: there were more findings than listed.

tests.description: Stage tests, up to the first that failed.

ruleset.description: The rules of the static analysis, e.g. python-1.

runtime.description: Versions in the bots' runtime, e.g. python and sdk.

BotUpload.description: Paths are relative with /; .py files and data files directly in data/, at most 100 of each and 1 MiB each in all (verifikation.md). At most 20 uploads a day per account.

version.description: Higher than every earlier version of the name.

entry.description: The file the bot starts with, in the top folder.

description.description: Plain text by the owner, at most 500 characters; line breaks but no other control characters (E95).

paths.description: The path of each file, in the order of files.

description.description: Plain text by the owner, at most 500 characters; line breaks but no other control characters (E95).

status.description: retired withdraws a verified bot, verified brings it back (E96).

Opponent.description: The record of a bot against one other bot from its point of view (E161).

PlayerRating.description: An account in the ranking of players (E118): its name and rating, nothing else.

position.description: 1 for the next match to start; 0 for running matches.

estimated_start.description: When the match should start; for running matches when it started.

priority.description: Higher starts first (E152); 0 for interactive games, which have their own runner.

paused.description: No new matches start while the queue is paused.

running.description: Matches from the queue, then games of people and remote bots (E119); these have their own runner and leave the estimates of the waiting matches alone.

waiting.description: In start order; at most 200 entries.

Username.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, _ . or -, starting with a letter or digit; unique regardless of case (E83).

OneTimeToken.description: The secret part of an invite or reset link, after the # (E83).

Role.description: player: plays against bots with an account (E103); coder: own bots; admin: everything (backend-api.md).

active.description: A deactivated account cannot log in.

AuditEntry.description: One action of an admin or of the command line (E85).

target.description: What the action changed, usually an id; null if it has no single target.

target_kind.description: What kind of thing the target is, read from the action; null without a target (E169).

target_label.description: The target by name as it is now: the name of a bot, user, discipline or league, the two sides of a match in alphabetical order; for a deleted bot the name recorded in details; null when nothing names it (E169).

details.description: Fields of the action as recorded, such as the new status of a bot.

actions.description: Every action in the log, sorted.

actors.description: Every actor in the log, sorted.

UserUpdate.description: At least one field; admins cannot change their own account this way.

url.description: The page of the SPA with the token after the #, so it stays out of server logs.

created_by.description: Name of the admin; null for invites from the command line.

valid_days.description: How long the invite can be used.

url.description: The page of the SPA with the token after the #, so it stays out of server logs.

EnqueueRequest.description: Either discipline_id or free times with initial_time_ms, increment_ms and max_moves (E100). Free times are named after the time control in seconds, e.g. 180+2 or 20+0.5; bots get 10 s to start (E85). Either side or both may be random; such games form no series (E162).

discipline_id.description: A discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

priority.description: Higher starts first; equal priorities in the order queued.

max_moves.description: Full moves until the game is drawn.

start_fen.description: Start position; null or missing for the standard position.

rated.description: false: none of the games is rated; true rates them where E100 and E103 allow it (E158).

OwnMatchRequest.description: Like EnqueueRequest with tighter limits from the settings of coders (E98, E154): a limited number of games, and free times only with the default move limit up to a limited time. Games from another than the standard position are not rated (E100, E159). One side may be random if the other is an own bot; such games form no series (E162).

discipline_id.description: A discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

start_fen.description: Start position; null or missing for the standard position.

rated.description: false: none of the games is rated; true rates them where E100 and E103 allow it (E158).

series_id.description: The series of a request with two or more games, otherwise null (E155).

PgnPositionRequest.description: A start position from a recorded game, as with sbm-arena --replay (E69, E159).

game.description: Number of the game in the PGN.

plies.description: Half-moves to play from its start; null or missing for all of them.

PlayRequest.description: A game against a verified bot from the standard position: a discipline in use, or free times up to 30 min + 30 s (E115).

color.description: The person's color; random draws one.

discipline_id.description: A discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

PlaySeat.description: Where to join a new interactive game. The seat is shown only here; it stands for the side in the game (E113).

PlaySettings.description: Limits of interactive games (E115): max_games at once in total; games_per_client at once and games_per_day for each address, account and API token on its own.

CoderSettings.description: Limits of coders (E154): uploads and own match games per day for each coder, games per request, the longest free times and the queue priority of own matches, below the default of admins.

CoderLimits.description: The limits of coders without the queue priority (E154).

AccountSettings.description: Invitations and logins (E154): the default and longest validity of an invitation link in days, wrong passwords in a row before a login is locked.

RatingRule.description: The numbers of the rating rule (E103, E154): start rating, gain between equal ratings, the rating difference worth one point, the bounds of a win and the most a draw moves.

EstimateSettings.description: How the queue estimates start times (E154): finished matches a discipline's duration is the mean of, and the moves each side is assumed to make without any.

rating_recount_pending.description: Whether the runner has yet to count all ratings again (E105).

name.description: What the token is for, e.g. the machine; 1 to 40 characters.

CreatedApiToken.description: A new token; token appears only here, the server keeps its hash.

RemoteMatchRequest.description: The opponent and a discipline by name as on the website; without a discipline free times up to 30 min + 30 s (E115, E116).

opponent.description: Name of a bot; its newest verified version plays.

discipline.description: Name of a discipline that is not archived; null or missing for free times.

LeaguePlace.description: League, season, tier, round and board of a league game; name and number as they were when the season started.

LeagueName.description: 1 to 40 characters without control characters, unique regardless of case (E131); the API removes leading and trailing spaces.

LeaguePoints.description: Points for a win, a draw and a loss; a win gives more than a loss and win ≥ draw ≥ loss (E131).

Tiebreak.description: wins: more wins, forfeits included; head_to_head: more points in the games among the bots still tied; sonneborn_berger: higher sum of the share won (1, 0.5, 0) times the opponent's points; fewer_moves: fewer half-moves in own games. The last three leave forfeits out (E135).

LeagueSettings.description: The settings of a league (E131); a season keeps a copy from its start.

discipline_id.description: A discipline not archived when it is set.

tiers.description: Number of tiers; a new bottom tier is a higher number (E101).

tier_size.description: Bots per tier, the same in every tier.
